goldCeiling.verdict: 200 IS THE ARITHMETIC MAXIMUM OF THE PLAN I CHOSE, and the choice was deliberate. The only cap-raiser on this roster is stockpile (60g x2, +150 each -> 500). glowjack carries thief:true, and a standing stockpile is the switch that makes nearestGoldHolding non-empty, converting every thief from hero-chaser to gold-grabber (generation 106 measured that trade at 435 gold). I declined it and measured goldStolen: 0 with 8 thieves alive at the bank. Open question left for the next rider, named precisely: buy BOTH stockpiles LATE (t ~ 500-520) - theft integrates over the time the till stands, and with no wrecker on this roster there is no repair bill competing for the purse, so ~80s of exposure against +300 of ceiling is the one refinement I did not test.
